question: India’s men’s hockey team beat Pakistan to win a bronze medal in December 2021 at the:
solution:
The Correct answer is **__Asian Champions Trophy.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indian men's hockey team led by** Manpreet Singh **finished their Asian Champions Trophy 2021 campaign on Wednesday in **Dhaka**
 
• With a 4-3 win over arch-rivals Pakistan and earned the **bronze medal** in the coveted tournament.
 
• **India** came from behind to win the thrilling match 5-4 and bagged their first Olympic hockey medal since 1980. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Moin-ud-Dowlah Gold Cup Tournament is an Indian cricket competition that has been held in Hyderabad from 1930-31
 
• The ICC Champions Trophy is a** One-Day International cricket tournament organized by the International Cricket Council.** The 2013 tournament was intended to be the final edition of the Champions Trophy, but it was extended to 2017 due to its widespread popularity.
 
• A right-arm off-spinner highest class, Ghulam Ahmed was a gentleman cricketer. 
 
• He represented India for a decade with Vinoo Mankad and Subash.
